text: sorry shouldnt the distance between one vertex to another be considerd the edge? right? like if i have a plane, 4 edges, cut it one way. i get out of the 4 starting vertex now its 6 and i should have 6 edges, right?
resolution: Answered the user's plane-topology question with a live probe instead of theory: cut a fresh plane once headlessly and read the welded topology — weldedVertices=6 (their expected count) and editableEdges=7: the 6 boundary segments they were counting PLUS the cut seam itself, which is also a vertex-to-vertex edge. Confirmed the editor's model matches their intuition exactly (edges never span through a vertex); invited them to report if the viewport shows otherwise since that would be a display/pick bug, not topology. No code changed for this answer.
